title: Great addition to USA Pan's nonstick bakeware lineup - made in USA too!
text:
Great addition to USA Pan's nonstick bakeware lineup - made in USA too!. I own numerous pans by USA Pan... in fact, it's the only brand I bake with. From muffin pans to jelly roll pans to cookie sheets, sheet pans and specialty pans, USA Pan is my brand of choice due to its durability, ease of cleaning, and best of all, the fact that it's manufactured in the USA (an increasing rarity these days).

In the past, I baked with a stoneware pizza pan that was made in PRC...I try to buy American (or European) whenever possible, as I don't trust the materials being used as I've had several bad experiences in the past with substandard products / defective coatings, etc.

So when I was offered the chance to try out the USA Pan pizza stone, I was thrilled to find a made-in-the-US alternative for my homemade pizza crusts and rustic breads.

First of all, this pan is LARGE - so for those of you with smaller countertop convection ovens, this will be too large to fit. It has a wonderfully solid feel and heft. Made from clay mined in Tennessee, best of all, the pizza stone features the same nonstick finish used on their metal bakeware, meaning that you will no longer be scrubbing off the seared-on pizza cheese or drips that plague regular stoneware. It comes with a 3-year warranty.

Because this item is stoneware, never place a warm pan in cold water to reduce risk of breaking. Due to the nonstick finish, avoid steel wool or abrasive cleaners. Also, do NOT preheat and do not exceed 450. By following these tips, your USA Pizza Stone should give you many years of faithful use.

description: The USA Pan 14" Pizza Stone pan is Handcrafted artisan stoneware with a nonstick finish. Using clay mined from Tennessee by American miners, each piece is uniquely formed and inspected by an expert artisan before it is finished with our patented AMERICOAT plus nonstick, the same nonstick that is used in our high-performance USA Pan aluminized steel bakeware for easy release and cleaning. This pan provides superior heat conductivity with no hot or cold spots and eliminates the need for seasoning, cooking spray, or grease. USA Pan stoneware is made in the USA and comes with a 3-year limited warranty.
